concept.hr: SRAM drži bit u bistabilu; DRAM u naboju koji curi i treba osvježavanje
concept.en: SRAM holds a bit in a latch; DRAM in charge that leaks and must be refreshed

summary.hr: Ćelija 6T SRAM i ćelija 1T1C DRAM dobivaju iste upise, čitanja i čekanja. DRAM naboj curi, čitanje ga razara, a bez osvježavanja bit se gubi.
summary.en: A 6T SRAM cell and a 1T1C DRAM cell get the same writes, reads and waits. DRAM charge leaks, a read destroys it, and without refresh the bit is lost.
